title: Personalized predictions of adverse side effects of the COVID-19 vaccines.
summary: Primary Methods/Results use prospective adverse-effect reports from 19,943 vaccine recipients in Iran and Switzerland across six vaccines; multiple ML models predict eight side effects using demographic/health features, with ROC-AUC evaluation. Retrospective prediction from collected reports; no causal vaccine-risk claim.
